payload.title: Disambiguate synthetic RI fixture identities and separate them from observed-source tests
payload.summary: Priority2 test maintenance. tests/context/retrieval/lexical/_helpers.py _digest concatenates string parts without length framing. Independently authored _document("a","bc") and _document("ab","c") have identical document identities. Localization generation/association helpers reuse this synthetic source and manually reuse snapshot IDs across different resources. Pure scoring fixtures are legitimate, but cannot alone establish canonical observation, content hashing or freshness correctness.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: collision pair has distinct synthetic identities after a bounded fixture correction; retain deterministic lexical score tests and explicitly synthetic negative frames; add or identify real observation-to-localization integration with distinct snapshots, unchanged content, changed content, foreign/stale inputs and retained-source assertions. Audit dependent fixture expectations before replacing a helper. Keep domain-specific fixtures where semantics differ; no universal fixture framework or production identity change.
payload.uncertainty: This is a demonstrated test-helper collision, not a demonstrated production ContentIdentity collision. Fixed caller IDs can be useful adversarial fixtures; label intent rather than banning all manual construction. Existing role-input tests use real filesystem observation and remain valuable independent coverage.
